title_o: The rejection of moral rebels: Resenting those who do the right thing.

replications.quote: Coded as not replicated: Replicate = 0 (the project's binary success indicator combining significance and direction).

Subjective replication success rating = 0 (failed). The replication report rated each sub-outcome on a 0-1 scale; the row is recorded as failed only when all sub-outcomes equal 0, successful only when all equal 1, and mixed for any value strictly between.
